source: shipped shell at HEAD, with drafts/pc-shell 01-06 (and their EDITs), drafts/mobile-shell 05, 08 and 09 (and 09's EDIT G1) applied in memory by godot_menus.py

items.label: Print sheet (PDF)…
items.reason: No print or PDF writer exists. The streaming writer has PNG, BigTIFF and JPEG only (export_options.rs FORMAT_NAMES).

items.label: VTT battle map (grid + walls)…
items.reason: No virtual-tabletop format exists in this build: no grid calibration, wall or light data is computed or written.

rows.label: Previous selection
rows.reason: Not built yet: each workspace keeps its own selection and nothing records the ones before, so there is nothing to step back or forward to. It arrives with the one shared selection (PC_SHELL_PROPOSAL.md §3.1, milestone PC-1).

rows.label: Next selection
rows.reason: Not built yet: each workspace keeps its own selection and nothing records the ones before, so there is nothing to step back or forward to. It arrives with the one shared selection (PC_SHELL_PROPOSAL.md §3.1, milestone PC-1).

rows.label: Places without notes is in Records

items.label: Alternate frames
items.reason: Not built. The spec's own note is that alternate-frame rendering only helps the 3D view, and the 3D view (Window ▸ 3D view) draws no terrain yet, so there are no 3D frames to alternate. Selecting it would be indistinguishable from Single device while implying otherwise.

items.label: Reduce working res
items.reason: Not built. Nothing in this pipeline computes a stage at a reduced grid and resamples back up -- LOD tile synthesis resamples an already-finished field, which is a different operation. Left visible so the gap is stated rather than silently missing.

rows.label: Try the GPU again
rows.reason: Nothing to clear: no GPU readback has failed this session, so nothing is banned. When one does fail, that grid size and every larger one are refused on that adapter until the app restarts -- and this row is what lifts it, after a driver update or on a smaller world.

rows.label: Anti-aliasing · anisotropy
rows.reason: SS2.5 asks for off / MSAA 2x / 4x / 8x and anisotropy 1-16. Both are 3D-view settings, and the 3D view (Window ▸ 3D view) draws no terrain yet, so there is nothing for a sample count to act on. The 2D map path composites whole rasters, where a sample count means nothing -- bolting MSAA onto it would be a control with no effect.

rows.label: Colour management — CARTO ▸ Colours ▸ Colour management
3D viewport defaults
rows.reason: SS2.5's four parameters verbatim -- relief exaggeration, detail, light, flatten oceans -- replacing the reference's #genV3dSec, and exempt from the finalize lock. The 3D view (Window ▸ 3D view) draws no terrain yet, so there is nothing for these defaults to set; they arrive with its terrain. Its vertical scale will start at true scale, 1.0x, not the 2D relief value above.

rows.label: Open panels in their own window

items.label: Inspect
items.reason: Not built yet: the right dock shows one thing at a time and has no tabs. Inspect, Note and Ask arrive when it becomes the Context panel (PC_SHELL_PROPOSAL.md §3.3, milestone PC-4).

items.label: Note
items.reason: Not built yet: the Note tab arrives with milestone PC-5 (PC_SHELL_PROPOSAL.md §3.4). Meanwhile Story ▸ Notes for this place opens a settlement's note in the vault window.

items.label: Ask (assistant)
items.reason: Not built yet: the Ask tab arrives with milestone PC-6 (PC_SHELL_PROPOSAL.md §3.5). Meanwhile Story ▸ Assistant panel… opens the assistant in its own window.

items.label: Pin to the current subject
items.reason: Not built yet: the right dock always shows the latest pick and cannot hold one subject while you select another. Pinning arrives with the Context panel (PC_SHELL_PROPOSAL.md §3.3, milestone PC-4).

items.label: Follow the selection
items.reason: Not built yet: there is no pin to release, because the right dock always follows the latest pick. It arrives with the Context panel (PC_SHELL_PROPOSAL.md §3.3, milestone PC-4).

items.label: History
items.reason: Not built yet: History arrives as a tab of the Context panel (PC_SHELL_PROPOSAL.md §3.3, Ruling DY; milestone PC-4). Meanwhile the Place editor's Timeline and Political history tabs, and the Factions window's History tab.

items.label: Economy
items.reason: Not built yet: Economy arrives as a tab of the Context panel (PC_SHELL_PROPOSAL.md §3.3, Ruling DY; milestone PC-4). Meanwhile the Place editor's Economy & notables tab, and the Factions window's Economy tab.

items.label: Military
items.reason: Not built yet: Military arrives as a tab of the Context panel (PC_SHELL_PROPOSAL.md §3.3, Ruling DY; milestone PC-4). Meanwhile the Factions window's Military tab; a selected place's garrison is in the right dock.

items.label: Faith, culture & relations
items.reason: Not built yet: Faith, culture & relations arrives as a tab of the Context panel (PC_SHELL_PROPOSAL.md §3.3, Ruling DY; milestone PC-4). Meanwhile the Factions window's Relations tab (relations and faith) and its Identity tab (culture).

items.label: Territory
items.reason: Not built yet: Territory arrives as a tab of the Context panel (PC_SHELL_PROPOSAL.md §3.3, Ruling DY; milestone PC-4). Meanwhile the Factions window's Territory tab.

items.label: City layout
items.reason: Not built yet: City layout arrives as a tab of the Context panel (PC_SHELL_PROPOSAL.md §3.3, Ruling DY; milestone PC-4). Meanwhile the Place editor's Layout tab, and the City viewer.

items.label: Here
items.reason: Not built yet: Here arrives as a tab of the Context panel (PC_SHELL_PROPOSAL.md §3.3, Ruling DY; milestone PC-4). Meanwhile the right dock's cursor sample, its default view, reads the terrain under the cursor.

items.label: Routes & journeys
items.reason: Not built yet: Routes & journeys arrives as a tab of the Context panel (PC_SHELL_PROPOSAL.md §3.3, Ruling DY; milestone PC-4). Meanwhile the right dock shows a picked route, and Story ▸ Journey planner and Saved journeys… plan and list journeys.

items.label: Links
items.reason: Not built yet: Links arrives as a tab of the Context panel (PC_SHELL_PROPOSAL.md §3.3, Ruling DY; milestone PC-4). Meanwhile the Place editor's Vault notes tab and the Markdown vault window list a note's backlinks.

items.label: Recent & bookmarks
items.reason: Not built yet: Recent & bookmarks arrives as a tab of the Context panel (PC_SHELL_PROPOSAL.md §3.3, Ruling DY; milestone PC-4). Nothing shows the selection history yet: it arrives with one selection (milestone PC-1), and bookmarks are new.

items.label: Reset panel
items.reason: Not built yet: there are no tabs to rearrange. It arrives with the Context panel (PC_SHELL_PROPOSAL.md §3.3, Ruling DY; milestone PC-4).

rows.label: Documentation
rows.reason: No in-app documentation exists, and SS2.7 names no URL to open instead. The reference is the repository's own documents (README.md, DECISIONS.md, ARCHITECTURE.md and the scope documents), which are not present beside this build -- an exported build ships res:// inside the .pck and nothing else. Running from the repository enables this row.
